title: Cancer-Specific Heterogeneity in the Incremental Explanatory Value of Transcript Usage for Protein Abundance
description: Frozen analysis code, derived gene-level and cancer-level results, source manifests, and figure exports for 1,027 case-level matched tumors across ten CPTAC cohorts. Two co-primary inverse transformations are preserved.
